properties.name: Threshold bar
properties.description: Bars any framed opening (door, gate, arch, or gap between two walls) so that nothing passes in either direction until she lifts the bar.

properties.name: Bell of passage
properties.description: Setting or lifting a bar requires striking her bronze bell so that its tone is heard at the opening, at 40 dB or louder.

properties.name: Consent sense
properties.description: She knows whether anything approaching an opening she guards intends to cross it, while that opening is within her sight.

properties.name: Oath of fixed ways
properties.description: She must never shorten, lengthen, fold, or reroute the distance or direction of any path or passage, nor knowingly help anyone do so. Barring a passage closed is not rerouting it.

properties.name: Framed only
properties.description: A bar can be set only on an opening with a defined frame. Open ground cannot be barred.

properties.name: Watch-bound
properties.description: While a bar holds, she must keep the opening in sight. If she loses sight of it, the bar fails.

visual_traits.descriptor: broad and steady, built for standing watch
silver-streaked black hair in a single heavy braid
long oxblood cloak over iron-studded leather
a hand-sized bronze bell on a leather strap
an archway gone still and impassable, the last note of a bronze bell hanging in the air

exclusion_candidates.reason: Informs her watch, but setting or lifting a bar does not depend on it
Applies only while a bar holds; a fusion that does not use her bar has no basis to inherit it
